title: BLAME! Academy and So On
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A full-color anthology of Tsutomu Nihei short works. Its centerpiece, BLAME! Academy, parodies the characters of his cyberpunk epic BLAME! by placing them in a Japanese school; other stories include a millennia-long war between two soldiers (Zeb-noid), a sequel-like tale of a Net Sphere Engineer, and a story of a silicon creature searching for Killy. Kodansha rates it 16+.
life_message: No single message; the collection mixes affectionate self-parody with bleak far-future survival stories.
